name: Hatoba
source:
"It’s such a great event, too...

But you guys are all just clumping together with other androids.

Your guards are way too high—way too high!

You really need to loosen up a little."

An "emo-style" android who occasionally drops by the bar *Overhaul*.

While he can be a bit gloomy and sometimes has a sharp tongue, he is capable of offering neutral, level-headed perspectives—without ever sugarcoating things— and as such, he often finds himself playing the role of mediator in arguments.

Lately, he’s been walking on air a little, having recently started dating a human.
